THE SMOKE / FIELD GUIDEGM FILE · v0.5.2
@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.cc6805cf975bde88.JournalEntryPage.b7a4eb23ff167c1b]{← Previous} / @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.ced14cab1f6d94db.JournalEntryPage.3e9358c94b97eef0]{Rules index}
LONDON INTERIORS

Mapped interiors and street scenes

Pat's Arches, the flat, Homerton A&E, the custody suite, and four street scenes the campaign keeps coming back to.

AR1 · Pat's Cycle Repairs MAPPED

Pat meets a claimant from @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.db462a370713a911.JournalEntryPage.168214c02948a6c4]{CH7} here. A witnessed agreement changes the workshop clientele and the Lea Boys next demand.

Existing room zone shopfront.

AR2 · Workshop Arch MAPPED

Spanner can inspect a disputed frame or finish a paid repair. Later work needs parts, time and an agreed share of the proceeds.

Existing room zone workshop.

AR3 · Chop Bay MAPPED

@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.2d9fbb694ed5e2d2.JournalEntryPage.b24d3a40394a0516]{CH2} uses the existing chop bay to test the Whippet. A hidden alteration becomes a buyer dispute, not an unexplained extra fee.

Existing room zone chop-bay.

AR4 · Pat's Office MAPPED

Pat sets the @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.2d9fbb694ed5e2d2.JournalEntryPage.0fb97a2328543408]{CH1} brief here and later negotiates ownership. Keep the current office and its existing access rules.

Existing room zone back-arch.

AR5 · Loading Yard MAPPED

@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.2d9fbb694ed5e2d2.JournalEntryPage.31fe63f142ee4d21]{CH3} starts with the van inventory. A later delivery can bring a rival collector, a borrowed vehicle or the goods won in CH8.

Existing room zone yard.

FL1 · Chicken Palace MAPPED

Mo starts @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.380caf621239c12b.JournalEntryPage.32a92965918487e6]{BM1} with a practical meal and receipt. @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.9f3d5bcde34ec080.JournalEntryPage.3d3e4cd2b4928c68]{S08} can turn the public counter into an ordinary witness to a false delivery.

Existing room zone chicken-shop.

FL2 · Back Alley MAPPED

A returning neighbour can see the @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.9f3d5bcde34ec080.JournalEntryPage.3d3e4cd2b4928c68]{S08} removal trolley here. This supplies a fresh lead if the crew misses the copied note.

Existing room zone back-alley.

FL3 · Stairwell MAPPED

@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.9f3d5bcde34ec080.JournalEntryPage.3d3e4cd2b4928c68]{S08} makes the stairwell a contested approach to the crew home. Run a conversation, a hurried arrival or a physical interception.

Existing room zone stairwell.

FL4 · Living Room MAPPED

Mo gives the existing opening rent reminder. @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.380caf621239c12b.JournalEntryPage.0221821e57adf8d4]{BM7} can bring a willing visitor here only if the residents agree to the risk and space.

Existing room zone living-room.

FL5 · Kitchen MAPPED

Use a home meal to settle a household bill, arrange a faction introduction or disagree over the next job without a public audience.

Existing room zone kitchen.

FL6 · Bathroom MAPPED

A private household conversation can reveal the cost of a recent job. A recovery here concerns a named lost possession, never an essential clue hidden behind a sanitary fixture.

Existing room zone bathroom.

FL7 · Bedroom MAPPED

A personal keepsake, sponsor letter or new lease offer brings a character ambition home. Ownership of the bedroom does not confer ownership of another NPC belongings.

Existing room zone bedroom.

AE1 · Ambulance Bay MAPPED

@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.380caf621239c12b.JournalEntryPage.20b3857b08eff2d6]{BM4} and @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.992bca85973f5687.JournalEntryPage.01b43c4291081cb5]{TU8} can involve a willing arrival or discharge journey. Staff retain control of treatment and the crew must name the person they are transporting.

Existing room zone ambulance-bay.

AE2 · Resus MAPPED

Use a critical incident as a timed consequence and an update from a consenting companion. The scene objective is obtaining help, not taking over treatment.

Existing room zone resus.

AE3 · Majors MAPPED

@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.985bf9584d9294e7.JournalEntryPage.f4d5d00a1615da84]{LB4} and @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.380caf621239c12b.JournalEntryPage.20b3857b08eff2d6]{BM4} connect the Halo incident to consenting adults and their separate accounts. Clinical access follows the fiction of the existing map, not a Renown purchase.

Existing room zone majors.

AE4 · Waiting Room MAPPED

@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.5816796be7174f14.JournalEntryPage.179900d7fa46d217]{LD5} starts with the person behind a file. A family member, driver and investigator can each want a different next step.

Existing room zone waiting-room.

AE5 · Triage MAPPED

An arrival dispute can cost time or reveal a missing contact. A failed social check changes the meeting arrangement without removing medical help.

Existing room zone triage.

AE6 · Discharge Lounge MAPPED

@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.d0f2613ac1d23e6b.JournalEntryPage.f371e3df5645797b]{RT6} can supply a voluntary message or safe next appointment. Nia need not be a patient or be physically waiting here to make the lead useful.

Existing room zone discharge.

AE7 · Pharmacy MAPPED

An ordinary belongings or prescription handover can reveal that two people share a name. Use this for an independent error and recovery scene, not a real drug-production clue.

Existing room zone pharmacy.

CU1 · Front Desk MAPPED

@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.5816796be7174f14.JournalEntryPage.7b640abfbcb175ce]{LD2} compares a fictional visitor account with the original desk record through an authorised conversation. The crew cannot command the station.

Existing room zone front-desk.

CU2 · Custody Desk MAPPED

A supporting contact can correct a booking error or arrange a permitted call. Failure leads to a later appointment and a documented dispute.

Existing room zone custody-desk.

CU3 · Cells MAPPED

@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.b6f2c39b51dec5f2.JournalEntryPage.fd474eac904a0150]{BB5} concerns a named adult and the account used against them. Access remains a permitted meeting or a later release conversation.

Existing room zone cells.

CU4 · Interview Room MAPPED

@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.5816796be7174f14.JournalEntryPage.cfe055768cdea049]{LD1}, @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.985bf9584d9294e7.JournalEntryPage.cd772286b56d8cd9]{LB5} and @UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.5816796be7174f14.JournalEntryPage.1c4e1b25b685d24d]{LD8} use the existing interview room for negotiated meetings and supported accounts. Vale offers receipts and referrals within her role.

Existing room zone interview.

CU5 · Property Store MAPPED

@UUID[Compendium.the-smoke.guides.JournalEntry.5816796be7174f14.JournalEntryPage.ef0b9e188b6e7cd1]{LD4} is a specific property discrepancy with a real claimant and an ordinary culprit. A receipt creates a recovery task instead of making every object a conspiracy clue.

Existing room zone property.

CU6 · Van Dock MAPPED

A permitted release or transfer can create a contested journey. Book a named driver and destination rather than granting unlimited faction transport.

Existing room zone van-dock.

LDN-SOUTH-HACKNEY | morning-ln | Existing exterior only.

EX-WATERDEN · Waterden Road recovery route MAPPED

LDN-VICTORIA-PARK | waterden-rd-1 | Existing exterior only.

LDN-OLD-FORD | bow-breakers-yard | Existing exterior only.

London overview LDN OVERVIEW MAPPED

Use the current overview to mark three available offers, one local lead, earned interior access, informed faction stance and the next visible city-front move. The final night has four fronts: public programme; money and signatures; premises and people; transport and the official account. Attach each booked ally to a specific action and time.
